# Evaluate Once

Source: [wiki article 4788](../archive/4788.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Evaluate Once](../../api/values/evaluate-once.md).

<a id="wiki-4788-n1"></a>

- Evaluate Once freezes a subexpression's first value per action/condition while surrounding expression continues reevaluating.

<a id="wiki-4788-n2"></a>

- Use it on a for-loop offset inside reevaluated effect position to keep each effect's initial offset while following a player.
